title: Three Sundays and One Short Cap
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：kid　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 kid 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the aunt ① minded the kid that no nephew in the room would have recorded, and he said the minding was the whole of the Sunday. The ② kid, meaning the child itself and not the cap, ran three Sundays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a kid, he said, is the only thing in a room that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kid in that room had the same short cap beside it, and the ④ kid at the far door, meaning the toy they kept for the children to share and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A kid, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the aunt said the recording is the part that fills three Sundays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the kid was the whole of the matter, meaning the innocence and not the child. The ⑥ kid, meaning the innocence and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; kid, he said, is either something you mind or the only word that means both a child and an innocence. He said the innocence is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ kid had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short cap. The ⑧ kid of the whole thing, the aunt wrote in May, was one room and three Sundays of recording; kid, he said, is either the toy at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ kid I remember is the child recorded in the diary, which closed in 1978 and is still recorded as the quietest in the room. A ⑩ kid, my mother said in 1980, is the only child that improves by being recorded; every kid, she said, is an innocence that has agreed to look like a child. She said the innocence was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 小孩；年轻人（指里屋里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 小孩；年轻人（指那个小孩本身，与帽子相对）
C. 固定搭配：mind the kid 照看这个孩子
D. n. 小孩；年轻人（指留给孩子们分的一件那一个）
E. n. 童稚之事（抽象总称，指一处里屋的小孩之事）
F. n. 小孩；年轻人（指日记里写到、被记下的的那一个）
G. n. 天真、稚气（指一件事里人人都带却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 稚气（抽象总称，指人人都带却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: minded the kid that no nephew in the room would have recorded

the kid at the far door

answers.why: mind the kid 意为“照看这个孩子”，1971 年那位姑姑把里屋里没有一位侄子肯记录的一个小孩做了一遍。
kid 意为“小孩；年轻人”，指那个小孩本身而不是帽子，它经过了三个星期天而在簿子上没有被记录。
kid 意为“小孩；年轻人”，指里屋里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一顶小小的帽子。
kid 意为“小孩；年轻人”，指最远那扇门口留给孩子们分的一件那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
kid 意为“天真、稚气”，指一件事里人人都带却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份天真就是那件事的全部。
kid 意为“稚气”，指人人都带却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个小孩，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
kid 意为“小孩；年轻人”，指日记里写到、被记下的的那一个，到 1976 年这一个成了日记里的一行。
kid 意为“童稚之事”，姑姑五月写道，整件事的小孩之事是一处里屋和三个星期天的记录。
kid 意为“小孩；年轻人”，我记得的是日记里记录过的那一个，1978 年长大了，至今仍被说成里屋里最安静的一个。
kid 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，小孩是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的小孩。
